environment: Ubuntu isolated Docker; read-only existing dataset and intercepted destructive commands

checks.name: real list exposes deletion; opening/cancelling only reads and restores originating row/page
archive prerequisite pauses first, prevents repeated commands and never deletes prices
native final confirmation cancel sends no destructive request
explicit confirmation submits latest reviewed token once and displays completion
durable references remain visible and block deletion
empty or already reclaimed history cannot submit deletion
review conflict resets confirmation and preserves prices
partial archive failure is visible; idempotent retry never reclaims prices
detail entry and maintenance guidance preserve return context
